info.name: Authomatic City Services — All Gateway APIs
info.description: Unified collection for all API Gateway services. Source collections are grouped into top-level folders; variables are namespaced per source collection to avoid collisions. Run a folder from top to bottom.

exec: ['dd720703-bc5d-4278-8180-29f1f0909e0d', pm.collectionVariables.get('new_services_cancel_brigade_id')].forEach((brigadeId, i) => pm.sendRequest({url: pm.collectionVariables.get('base_url') + '/locations/record', method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('new_services_access_token')}, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({event_id: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'), event_version: 1, occurred_at: new Date().toISOString(), device_id: 'postman-dispatch-' + i, vehicle_id: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'), brigade_id: brigadeId, sequence: Date.now() + i + 1, latitude: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('new_services_latitude')), longitude: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('new_services_longitude')), speed_kmh: 0, heading: 0, accuracy_meters: 5, simulated: true})}}, (err, res) => pm.test('secondary brigade location recorded', () => { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.be.within(200, 299); })));
